summary: This is an 8-K filed by Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company (SPAC), reporting a deposit of $125,000 to extend its trust account's deadline to consummate a business combination by one month, from July 15, 2026, to August 15, 2026. No business combination, acquisition, or special-situation event is announced; this is a routine extension filing to maintain the trust account. No terms, advisors, or recommendations are provided. The filing does not trigger any special-situation category; it is a procedural step common to SPACs seeking additional time to find a target. As a routine extension without material event, it is classified as None.
